body:
Hey @prateeksharma2988 it would be good if you could provide a small reproducer project where we can observe the behaviour you are describing, thanks!

Also, how do you restart your application? do you let it fully initialize before stopping it or you stop it mid initialization ?

Thanks for reporting.

I can actually see how this could happen and why it happens intermittently.
Essentially the code of the `quarkus-hibernate-validator` extension needs to move away from `BeanContainerListener` and instead change to produce beans via `SyntheticBeanBuildItem`
I can have a look at doing that if no one else wants to pick it up.
https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/47947 is what I have in mind

Thanks @geoand  for the quick response. Let me have a look at the fix. 
Thanks for your support.

@geoand are planning to backport the changes to any of the LTS 3.15 or 3.20 ? We tried taking your changes and building 3.15.4 but we are facing challenges in building the jar. It would be good to know in which version we can get these changes.
